analysis:
PORTFOLIO REVIEW: The numbers are alarming and demand honesty. Win rate 9.1%, profit factor 0.03x, Sortino -14.90 — this is capital destruction, not compounding. The strategy has not been producing alpha; the sole obligation right now is capital preservation and stopping the bleeding.

POSITION-BY-POSITION:
• AMP (-9.89%, $9,367): THESIS BREAK. This is the third time we have been in AMP — it was stopped out at -3.12% and again at -3.81%, and the current position is now -9.89%. Fighting the same tape three times is not value investing, it is stubbornness. AMP does NOT appear on today's screened candidate list, confirming its trend is still impaired. This position should be exited manually. The schema prevents a formal SELL trade for non-candidates, but the analytical recommendation is clear: cut AMP. Do not wait for the full stop.
• NVDA (+2.79%): Only winner. Position is extending toward the 52-week high (86th percentile). Hold with trailing stop discipline; do not add here as it would be a late-cycle entry.
• MCO (-0.41%), FOXA (-0.71%), BR (-2.86%): All in minor red territory with theses intact. Watch closely but no action required today.

NEW BUYS: We are at 5 positions (the maximum), market regime is UPTREND which is supportive, but the screener has several attractive setups that are worth monitoring. IT (Gartner) is the standout — fwd P/E 11.5x, PEG 0.75, ROE 113%, basing at 45% of 52w range — but opening a 6th position while AMP is unresolved and performance metrics are this poor would violate discipline. CRM and CVX are also interesting but either extended or at high range percentile. Proposed new trades: ZERO. Cut AMP first, then reassess whether the freed capital and reduced position count (to 4) creates room for a high-conviction entry in IT or CRM on a proper pullback. Cash is a position. The headroom exists but the conviction threshold is not met while the book is at max concentration and max drawdown. Silence is the correct trade today.
